patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with a large left-aligned text block and a right-aligned grid of project showcases.
Consistent use of all-lowercase sans-serif typography for all text elements, including headings, body, and navigation, creating a distinct brand voice.
High-contrast black and white base palette, accented by a single vibrant red for CTAs and key icons, and a subtle light blue for background textures.
A sticky header remains fixed at the top of the viewport, while a large, pixelated background texture appears to be fixed or slowly parallaxing behind the scrolling content.
Project showcase sections are presented in a multi-column grid, with each project clearly delineated by a horizontal rule and labeled with 'WEBSITE' and 'BRAND' categories.

technique_notes: The main navigation and logo are implemented as a sticky header, remaining fixed at the top of the viewport during vertical scroll.
A large, dithered, light blue image is positioned as a fixed background element, creating a layered depth effect as the main content scrolls over it.
All text, from headings to body and navigation, is rendered in a consistent all-lowercase sans-serif font, establishing a distinct and modern brand voice.

design_tokens.type_scale: Distinctive all-lowercase sans-serif headings are moderately larger than body text, maintaining a clean hierarchy without extreme size differences.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with ample whitespace around major content blocks and a tighter grid for project showcases.

standout: The site's distinctive use of all-lowercase typography across all text elements, combined with a retro-digital pixelated background texture, creates a unique blend of modern minimalism and nostalgic tech aesthetic. The repeating 'book a call' footer also adds a memorable, almost quirky, touch.
